referenceFunction.generalComment: The infrastructure module includes 4 tanks with storage capacitiy of 4000 m3 each, totalling to a storage capacitiy of 16000 m3. The life time of the tanks was assumed to be 50 years. This infrastructure module has a high uncertainty and should only be seen as an approximation of the infrastructure for regional storage of liquid chemical.; UUID: 37f6729c-9dd3-3809-800f-df00fa277970
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Material for construction, transport of material to construction site, no energy use for construction included, dismantling and disposal processes, no contamination assumed for disposal, land use included.
referenceFunction.name: Liquid storage tank, chemicals, organics

geography.text: Based on weak data valid for Switzerland

technology.text: Most data origins from the storage of fuels, there is high uncertainty in the technological correlation. This may also affect the materials used for the tank wall. Uncertainties occur for the disposal processes for the tanks after use because of approximations with processes for residential buildings.

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Estimation from literature and from pictures and maps of 3 sites for fuel storage
